purpose: Draws one Plan card for a record of type Function, Function Constraint, Solution, Solution Constraint, Value or Development Resource: the lines that type has, in order, each change saved with a version check, the type changeable live, with every read and write supplied by the host.
namedChanges: Imports (lines 5-136): each component and function of a merged unit is imported from that unit: `PlanButtonRow` from `plan-button-row`; `FieldRow` from `field-row`; `modalIsOpen` and `insideOpenLayer` from `open-popups` (`insideOpenLayer` is `components/records/planLeave.ts` and is the same code: only its import of `modalIsOpen` differs); `CardGroup` and `CardIconName` from `card-group`; `useCardMode` from `card-mode`; `PlanImpacts` from `plan-impacts`; the seven link lines from `plan-tag-links`; `PlanDescriptionParts` from `description-parts-view`; `PlanTypeLevelVersion` from `plan-type-level-version`; `PlanAuthority` and `PlanStakeholders` from `plan-stakeholder-lines`; `PlanSource` from `plan-source`; the five Value bodies and `PlanValuePictureBody` from `value-scale-line`, `value-qualifiers-line`, `value-endpoint-line`, `value-levels-line`, `value-meters-line` and `value-illustration`, and `ValueLineProps` from `value-line-kit`; `isTypeName`, `linkAddress`, `readPartOfFact`, `solutionOfFunctions` and `solutionsTargeting` from `plan-links-model`; the `planCard.ts` names from `plan-card-facts`; the `planConstraint.ts` names and the pure parts of `planStakeholders.ts` from `plan-stakeholders-model`; `PlanTypeField`, `TYPE_TRIGGER_ATTR` and `PlanTypeReplaceAsk` from `plan-type-field`; the `planKinds.ts` names from `plan-kinds`; the `planValue.ts` names and `ValueCardData` from `value-card-model`; `MoveStopped` and the four Value hooks from `value-card-write`; `isPartType` from `description-parts-model`; `impactsOnSolution` from `plan-impacts-model`; `typeLocalName` from `type-curie`; the `planLevels.ts` names (`useProjectLevels` and the rest) from `project-levels`; `OrgRecordHit` from `record-picker`; `RecordRelation` from `relation-role`; `BaseRecord` and `GridRecord` from `base-record`. Every function and constant of these that is a plain function was compared with the source's, comments aside, and is the same code, except `typeLocalName`, which `type-curie` writes with a local for the match so that an unchecked index is not used (the same result); `isTypeName` is `type-key`'s, re-exported by `plan-links-model`, and compares the same two keys. The private copies below were compared the same way.

`@tanstack/react-query` is gone: `useQueryClient()` is not called (the query client stays in the host), and each `qc.*` call, query key and cache helper is a host member (see above). `planRecordKey`, `relationsKey` and `STAKEHOLDER_TYPE_SET_QUERY_KEY` are not in the unit: the host forms its own keys from the arguments.

Each host call is made with the same arguments, in the same place and order as the source's call, but for what the query client or the key did: `liveCachedRow(qc, planVault, ...)` is `host.liveRow(planVault, ...)`; `ensureEtagUnchanged(qc, planVault, ...)` is `host.ensureEtagUnchanged(planVault, ...)`; `qc.getQueryData<RecordRelation[]>(relationsKey(id, uri))` is `host.getRelations(id, uri)` (the `const key = relationsKey(...)` lines are gone); `qc.setQueryData(key, ...)` is `host.setRelations(id, uri, ...)`; `qc.getQueryData<StakeholderTypeSet>(STAKEHOLDER_TYPE_SET_QUERY_KEY)` is `host.getKindSet()`; `qc.setQueryData(planRecordKey(id, uri), stored)` is `host.setRecordRead(id, uri, stored)`; `storePlanRow(qc, planVault, stored)` is `host.storePlanRow(planVault, stored)`; `reconcileAfterConflict(qc, planVault, ready)` is `host.reconcileAfterConflict(planVault, ready)`; `applyPatch`, `readRecord`, `memberEntityUri` are `host.applyPatch`, `host.readRecord`, `host.memberEntityUri`; the writers are called with a `!` after the member (`host.patchRecord!`, `host.migratedAuthorityRelation!`, `host.writeAuthorityRelation!`, `retype!.mutateAsync`); `e instanceof RecordConflictError` is `host.isConflict(e)`; the hooks `useSelfSource`, `useRelations`, `usePlanFind` (three calls), `usePersonAuthorities` are `host.useX`, and `useRetypeRecord(vaultId)` is `host.useRetypeRecord?.(vaultId)`; `qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["stakeholder-search", "authority"], refetchType: "active" })` is `host.invalidateAuthoritySearch()`; `<ConnectedCreateDialog open stakeholders source={null} initialTypeId="person" drawnVaultIds={[vaultId, planVault]} onClose onCreated />` is `host.renderCreateStakeholder({ open: true, stakeholders: true, source: null, initialTypeId: "person", drawnVaultIds: [vaultId, planVault], onClose, onCreated })`.
The card reads `host` from the new `PlanCardHostContext` (`usePlanCardHost`, private) first, in the component's first line; with no provider it throws.

One added line, after it: `if (!(host.patchRecord && host.useRetypeRecord && host.migratedAuthorityRelation && host.writeAuthorityRelation)) canEdit = false;`. That is the read-only behaviour: the same as `canEdit` false.

`PlanTypeField` is given four props the unit takes and the source's Type field read from the app: `search={host.searchTypes}`, `blankReach={host.blankReach}`, `onOpenOntology={host.openOntologyConcept}` and `renderTypeIcon={host.renderTypeIcon}`.
Comments: the tags of the changes that added them (`V19`, `V31`, `V32`, `V36 M1`..`M3`, `V37`, `V21 F6`, `V29/V30`) are taken out; the meaning is kept.

Kept inside, as in the source: the module counter `statusLineSerial` and the hidden `lineKey`, `setDraft` called during render (the baseline sync), `applyBuild` and its promise queue, `rollBackAfterFailure`, the status engine (`rememberStatusLine`, `commitStatusDate`, `putLines`, `addStatus`, `onNewStatusClick` with its script-click guard), the retype flow (`askType`, `adoptPerson`, `changeType`), the Value-only block (the version floor, the older lists, `moveOldLists`, `removeMade`, `retryRemoving`, `applyValueChange`, `enqueueScale`, `mergeQualifier`, `onRenameQualifier`), `QuietScope` (a document keydown in the capture phase and a mousedown), the focus-return effect (it looks up `[data-testid="plan-type-field"] [data-plan-type-trigger]`), `readRecord(id, planVault)` with the vault id in the `at` slot, and `migratedAuthorityRelation(..., vaultId, ...)` against `writeAuthorityRelation({ ..., vaultId: planVault })`.
